## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and configuration are documented.
- [ ] The `[Unreleased]` changelog is updated when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private code, personal data, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Security, platform, RPC, and frontend exposure implications were considered.
